documents.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Your Class: Recommended practices
documents.summary: Tier 4: Teaching-centre guide for instructors covering syllabus statements, assessment design, communicating with students, and academic misconduct. It defines when AI use is misconduct under the Student Academic Integrity Policy and discourages relying on AI detectors. It also addresses equity of access and alternative assessments for students who object to AI.
